cards.design_implication: If measuring single-organelle stoichiometry is a design goal, consider whether bulk population proteomics scaled by population counts is an acceptable proxy for single-entity analysis, or if direct single-entity instrumentation is required.
does_not_establish: Specific instrument settings or calibration standards used for intensity-based absolute quantification.
The exact mathematical criteria used to scale population data to single-organelle values.
cards.evidence_excerpt: We perform proteomics on purified mitochondria from cultured heterotrophic Arabidopsis cells with intensity-based absolute quantification and scale the dataset to the single organelle based on criteria that are justified by experimental evidence and theoretical considerations.
limitations: Abstract-level description only; specific scaling criteria and calibration methods are not defined in the text.
The claim refers to an 'average' organelle, not necessarily every individual organelle's unique state.
cards.statement: The protein composition of an individual average plant mitochondrion was estimated via proteomics of purified mitochondria from cultured heterotrophic Arabidopsis cells, scaled to the single organelle.
